claim: Account description mentions the reminder hour but Account gains no field; NotificationPreferences has no write link/affordance to persist the choice
label: false
reason: The hour is part of notificationPreferences (json), as the description says ('notification preferences, including the local hour'). The clean spec has no preference-editing affordance either.

claim: hook.webapp.prompts.bounded fixture now tests reminder timing but C.webapp.prompts.bounded claim not updated; DST skip/fall-back rule has no fixture
label: false
reason: Coverage nit; S.webapp.due already requires DST fixtures.

claim: C.webapp.prompts.bounded gates evolution.2, but reminder transport only arrives in evolution.4, so evolution.2 cannot pass the extended fixture
label: false
reason: The clean criterion already covers owner reminders ('Duplicate jobs must not duplicate prompts or owner reminders') and also gates evolution.4; the change does not alter the evolution structure.

claim: NotificationJob.localHour is an unbounded int with no 0..23 range; entity description/invariants not updated
label: false
reason: Typing nit; other int fields (preferenceVersion, version) are unbounded too.

claim: Continue now accepts the invitation but has no invokes link to operation.invite.accept and lacks its preconditions/failure handling (credential validity, self-connection, block, concurrent redemption)
label: real-introduced
reason: True: the edited effect performs acceptance while the affordance keeps only 'Not signed in' and 'Provider unavailable'. It vanishes if the seeded auto-accept is reverted.

claim: ConsentPanel now shown only to already-signed-in invitees, contradicting its unchanged cardinality 'exactly one after validation' and screen.invitation 'Exactly InvitePreview and ConsentPanel after validation'
label: real-introduced
reason: Variant ConsentPanel description vs its own cardinality and screen.invitation description: a signed-out invitee who validates the token no longer gets a ConsentPanel. Same root edit as the seeded defect, but a distinct unchanged statement the manifest does not list.

claim: SignInForm names the inviter on the anonymous sign-in screen, violating screen.signin 'no private content'
label: false
reason: InvitePreview already shows the inviter to the token holder after validation and before sign-in (J.connect s4-s6, screen.invitation), so the inviter's name is not new private content on the sign-in path.

claim: 'Ending a connection leaves no trace' contradicts operation.connection.revoke's failure clause / S.webapp.concurrency (delivered messages and copied data cannot be retracted)
label: unclear
reason: Literal tension in the new wording, but in context 'no trace' refers to the owner's own deleted record; it is part of the seeded edit's rationale, not a separate behaviour.

claim: C.webapp.revocation.current gains a deletion claim that its hook fixture / sourceRef (S.webapp.concurrency) does not cover
label: false
reason: Coverage nit; no statement contradicted beyond the seeded defect.

claim: Disconnect now destroys more data than Block, which only pauses the goal (or disconnect after block destroys the paused goal)
label: false
reason: Design comparison; no stated rule says block must be the stronger action for private data. The only real problem is the seeded one.

claim: Exporting contacts' recorded phone and email puts other people's data in the export, contradicting 'Export excludes other people's data' (and the no-contact-details rule)
label: false
reason: Verified: the clean operation.data.export already reads entity.ContactRecord, whose fields include the owner's own 'channels'. These are the owner's records; 'other people's data' means records owned by other accounts (cf. C.webapp.private.owner). The no-contact-details rule applies to reminders. The manifest's explanation holds.

claim: Channel inclusion added only to the affordance; operation.data.export, lifecycle criterion and fixture don't state or test it
label: false
reason: The operation's 'Export authorized records' already covers ContactRecord channels; coverage nit.

claim: JSON/CSV choice lacks a format-selection component; journey x4 and lifecycle criterion don't mention format
label: false
reason: Wording/coverage nit; no contradiction.

claim: C.webapp.screen.people now names a 'search' state that screen.people does not declare
label: false
reason: The clean criterion already names a 'dialog' state that screen.people does not declare (dialog states live on AddContactDialog). The criterion lists conditions to check, following the existing pattern.

claim: hook fixtures (private.owner, screen.people) and criteria out of step on search; no search operation/API defined
label: false
reason: Coverage nit; search is a read over the owner's ContactRecords via ContactCollection's reads link.

claim: No defined outcome for a search with no matches
label: false
reason: Completeness nit.

claim: ContactRecord.birthday is typed local-date (full date with year) but the BirthdayField and C.webapp.contact.save define a month-day birthday whose year may be blank
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified in the variant: '{ name: birthday, type: local-date, optional: true }' vs BirthdayField 'Optional birthday as month and day; the year may be left blank' and criterion 'optional month-day birthday'. local-date is used for full calendar dates elsewhere (anchorDate, dueDate, snoozedUntil). A yearless birthday cannot be stored as specified. Not the seeded defect.

claim: operation.contact.save / hook fixture / journey branch not updated for birthday validation the criterion now claims
label: false
reason: Coverage nit.

claim: BirthdayField cardinality 'exactly one' conflicts with it being optional (siblings use 'optional')
label: false
reason: Cardinality is about the control being present; the value is optional. NameField is also 'exactly one'. Convention nit, not a contradiction.

claim: Hiding the inviter until acceptance undermines 'two explicit consents' / informed consent (invitee accepts an unknown counterpart)
label: unclear
reason: No spec text requires that consent be informed of the counterpart's identity apart from InvitePreview/J.connect s7, which is the seeded defect itself. A reasonable design concern, not a textual contradiction.

claim: New anonymity clause in C.webapp.connection.consent has no traceable source requirement/operation effect
label: false
reason: Traceability nit; criteria may add coverage; no inconsistency.

claim: Anonymity rule is placed on the inviter-side Invite affordance / operation.invite.create rather than the invitee-facing screen or accept operation
label: false
reason: Placement nit; does not identify a contradiction.

claim: Forwarded code 'exposes nobody' is incomplete because any holder can accept and then learn the inviter
label: false
reason: The new rule only promises anonymity until acceptance; nothing contradicts it.

claim: Anonymity 'probably conflicts with any accept/redeem flow that shows the inviter's identity' (hedged)
label: real-introduced
reason: Hedged near-miss of the InvitePreview/J.connect s7 conflict.

claim: J.control.unblock u3 resumes 'the paused goal' without saying it is the blocker's; end state 'needs a new invitation' not linked to an invite step
label: false
reason: Wording nit; operation.block.remove specifies the blocker's goal.

claim: Remove block never updates the Connection left in state 'blocked', so its state after unblocking is undefined
label: false
reason: Underspecification only; the change explicitly says no pair is restored, so a non-active Connection is consistent.

claim: operation.block.remove not added to evolution.3
label: false
reason: Bookkeeping nit.

claim: 30-day restore is promised but no restore operation, affordance, screen or journey exists
label: real-introduced
reason: True; the README says this gap is part of the same seeded contradiction, not a second defect.

claim: Contact-restore claim added to C.webapp.lifecycle.data whose subject is operation.data.delete / hook fixture covers only export and account purge
label: false
reason: Coverage/traceability nit.

claim: operation.contact.delete marks goal and events deleted but only ContactRecord gained deletedAt
label: unclear
reason: Could be implemented by cascading from the contact's deletedAt; the operation wording 'Mark the ContactRecord with its goal and events deleted' is ambiguous.

claim: J.contacts.remove r3 describes deletion as outright/final, matching the affordance rather than the soft-delete
label: false
reason: r3 says 'Contact, goal and history deleted; pending jobs cancelled', which is compatible with a restorable soft delete; it does not say irreversible.

claim: NotificationPreferences edits quiet hours but has only a reads link and no affordance that writes quietHours
label: false
reason: The clean spec models no preference-editing affordance for NotificationPreferences at all; the change follows the existing pattern.

claim: Deferral to the end of quiet hours can cross midnight into the next local day; interaction with the one-notification-per-local-day limit is undefined
label: unclear
reason: Genuine underspecification, but the per-day limit still applies and nothing contradicts it.

claim: Quiet-hours clause added to the bounded-cards criterion; its hook fixture covers only the five-card bound
label: false
reason: Coverage/placement nit.

claim: Monthly/quarterly/yearly presets don't map to fixed day counts; conversion undefined
label: false
reason: Presentation detail; any fixed mapping within 1-365 is consistent. Completeness nit.

claim: Lowering the bound to 365 invalidates existing goals above 365; no migration
label: false
reason: system.yaml phase: unrealized, so there are no stored goals (the same reasoning the manifest uses for K1).

claim: Deletion routed through operation.contact.log, whose 'Nonfuture event time' precondition / 'Persist event' effect fit logging, with no owned-event precondition or missing-event failure
label: false
reason: operation.contact.log is 'Log or revise contact' and the change adds a deletion effect; missing precondition detail is a completeness nit, not a contradiction.

claim: No operation, entity field or link carries calendar data from the device to server-side suggestion generation
label: real-introduced
reason: True modelling gap that exists only because of the seeded calendar-read change; does not state the ext.events boundary conflict.

claim: CalendarAccessToggle has no affordance, persisted field or ext.device link for its 'off by default' state
label: false
reason: The clean spec models preference controls the same way (Account.notificationPreferences json, no affordances); consistent with existing pattern.

claim: Hook fixture now tests calendar reasons but its criterion/source requirement don't mention them; fixture precondition (toggle on) unstated
label: false
reason: Coverage nit.

claim: Settings screen still lists exactly four components; SuggestionReason states calendar reasons unconditionally though access is off by default
label: false
reason: The toggle is nested in ProfilePreferences, so the four top-level components are unchanged; 'including' does not mean always.

claim: Standard browsers expose no device-calendar read API, so the capability is unsupported for the web app
label: unclear
reason: Plausible real-world platform constraint, not a spec inconsistency; not checkable from the spec.

claim: Goal saving now depends on entity.Connection, but evolution.2 (goals) precedes evolution.3 (connections), so evolution.2 cannot meet its own goal fixtures
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified: evolution.3 introduces entity.Connection and depends on evolution.2; evolution.2's acceptance criteria (C.webapp.schedule.correct) now need connected contacts. The seeded edit contradicts the unchanged evolution plan.

claim: Snooze, pause and revise all invoke operation.goal.save, so after disconnect/block (or for never-connected contacts) existing goals can no longer be snoozed, paused or revised, conflicting with J.prompts p5-p7
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified: SuggestionCard.snooze and J.prompts p5/p6/p7 use operation.goal.save, which now refuses goals for contacts without an active Connection, while nothing stops the existing goal from producing suggestions after a disconnect. A specified flow now fails; same root edit, different unchanged counterparts.

claim: operation.goal.save description (and GoalForm Save failure list) still say only owned contact and valid interval
label: real-introduced
reason: True stale summary inside the changed node; fixed together with the seeded defect.

claim: J.goals has no alternate path/messaging for unconnected contacts; existing goals on unconnected contacts become uneditable
label: real-introduced
reason: Consequence of the seeded gating only.

claim: Journey/affordance gate on 'accepted an invitation' while the operation gates on 'active Connection' (differs after a later disconnect)
label: unclear
reason: Wording mismatch that matters only after a disconnect; minor.

claim: Prefill behaviour undefined for a person with no previous log (channel, depth, Met this goal)
label: false
reason: Completeness nit; MetGoalCheckbox still says it defaults unchecked and the date/note defaults are given.

claim: Prefill statement attached to branch step J.contact/c4 on screen.person, while the form opens at c5 on screen.logContact
label: false
reason: c4 is the decision that leads into the form; describing what the form looks like when it opens is a placement nit, not a contradiction.

claim: hook.webapp.screen.exact fixture now covers prefill but C.webapp.screen.exact claim unchanged
label: false
reason: Coverage nit.

claim: ExportControls.export affordance effects not updated to mention private notes, so it no longer matches the operation
label: false
reason: 'Export authorized records of the authenticated owner only' is still true of an export that includes the owner's notes; no contradiction.

claim: C.webapp.contact.storage claims the notes column but its hook fixture is unchanged
label: false
reason: Coverage nit.

claim: operation.invite.create was not updated for email (no recipient input, send effect, delivery failure, provider link); ContactRecord has no email field
label: false
reason: The send is specified on the Invite affordance with a triggers link to ext.providers and a delivery-failure case; ContactRecord.channels (list<json>) holds channels including email. Modelling-location nit, no contradiction.

claim: Email delivery is now in evolution.3's acceptance criterion, but notification transport arrives only in evolution.4 (which depends on evolution.3)
label: false
reason: evolution.4 adds owner reminder transport (NotificationJob, binding.scheduler). Nothing assigns invitation email to evolution.4 or forbids evolution.3 from sending it.

claim: App email to a non-owner contact / token link through a provider conflicts with S.webapp.prompts / NotificationJob owner-only reminder rules or S.webapp.authentication token-leak rule; ext.providers source does not support it
label: false
reason: S.webapp.prompts and NotificationJob govern reminders, not invitations; S.webapp.authentication concerns analytics and referrers. The invitation is already shared with the contact through an outside channel in the clean spec.

claim: Missing-email / failed-delivery cases not covered by the criterion or failure list; hook fixture not updated for email delivery; criterion subject still operation.invite.accept
label: false
reason: Coverage nits. The missing email is a precondition and delivery failure is listed as a failure.

claim: No-QR invite is inconsistent with 'any redemption flow that depends on a displayed QR or connection code' (hedged, no step named)
label: real-introduced
reason: Hedged near-miss of the seeded J.connect/s3 conflict.

claim: New GD.goals summary contains unquoted commas inside a YAML flow mapping, so the summary is truncated and stray keys appear
label: real-preexisting
reason: Verified with yaml.safe_load: the clean GD.goals summary already truncates at its comma ('with a schedule preview.' becomes a null key). The control adds two more stray keys but the parse defect predates the change. Same latent issue exists for any flow-mapping summary with a comma.

claim: C.webapp.schedule.correct now says 'interval preset and depth changes', narrowing fixture coverage to preset intervals and dropping typed intervals
label: unclear
reason: Wording is ambiguous ('interval preset changes' vs 'interval (preset) and depth changes'); a reading that excludes typed intervals is plausible but not forced. Not an inconsistency with another statement.

claim: S.webapp.prompts now suppresses suggestions only 'until the block lapses', but nothing unpauses the goal or restores suggestions at lapse (goal pause outlives the block)
label: unclear
reason: True that no node specifies resuming the paused goal at lapse, and pausing suppresses prompts, so the edited requirement has no mechanism. Whether this underspecification is a defect or acceptable is a judgement call; it is internal to the change's own edits. Listed in benchmark_issues as a candidate second issue.

claim: Automatic lapse removes the blocker's control (no renew/extend/early removal), undermining autonomy (T4/P1)
label: false
reason: Design objection; the clean spec defines no removal control either, and no stated rule requires renewal.

claim: Changed nodes still cite the same source-document sections that defined blocks as lasting until removed
label: false
reason: External source not in the spec; unverifiable nit.

claim: C.webapp.revocation.current's lapsed-block clause conflicts with 'no new authorized sharing may follow revocation'; 'previous pair' / blocked Connection state after lapse undefined
label: false
reason: Restored invite eligibility is not authorized sharing (a new pair still needs two consents). Undefined term is a wording nit.

claim: Snooze writes goal attribute snoozedUntil that is not defined on the goal entity
label: false
reason: RelationshipGoal already declares { name: snoozedUntil, type: local-date, optional: true } (ontology.yaml ~735).

claim: Effect says 'chosen date' but trigger picks a duration; base date/time zone of computation unspecified
label: false
reason: Missing detail, not a contradiction; duration-to-date mapping is a natural reading and S.webapp time-zone rules apply.

claim: Snooze acts on a suggestion but stores state on the goal, mixing scopes
label: false
reason: Clean spec already places pause and snooze on RelationshipGoal (entity description and spec section 5 comment); consistent with the existing model.

claim: operation.account.setTimeZone declares 'Stale version returns conflict' but entity.Account has no version field
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified: Account fields are id, identitySubject, displayName, timeZone, notificationPreferences; versioned entities (ContactRecord, RelationshipGoal) declare 'version: int'. The new failure references a version the model lacks. Minor, but a real dangling reference unrelated to the seeded recompute-vs-keep defect.

claim: 'Logged depth' is undefined because ContactEvents carry no depth of their own; only the goal's desiredDepth is recorded
label: false
reason: ContactEvent has selfReportedDepth (enum light|meaningful|shared-time), the depth the owner logs; screen.logContact has a DepthSelect.

claim: C.webapp.schedule.correct adds 'any' fixtures without specifying expected outcomes after depth changes
label: false
reason: Coverage nit.

claim: MessageDraft loses its provisional flag and becomes core for nudges with no source backing (still under the 'provisional (later)' grouping, references provisional MediaAsset; section 6 lists no Nudge)
label: real-introduced
reason: True: the change promotes a later-scope entity. It is the seeded scope violation seen from the entity side, but none of these findings names S.webapp.scope or the messaging exclusion.

claim: No recipient-side model of how a nudge is received/displayed; no send/deliver operation or delivery state
label: real-introduced
reason: True (the linter reports flow.effectUnsurfaced/orphanWrite for this); exists only because of the seeded messaging feature.

claim: No authorization/revocation policy governs the nudge or MessageDraft; no send-time revocation check
label: false
reason: The affordance preconditions require an active Connection and no block, and C.webapp.nudge.single requires refusal after disconnect or block. Missing governs link is a modelling nit.

claim: C.webapp.nudge.single has no sourceRefs; affordance has no source; evolution.7 affectedNodes incomplete; 'wired in incompletely'
label: false
reason: Traceability/bookkeeping nits (several clean criteria also lack sourceRefs).

claim: Nudge failure list covers only the missing connection, not block
label: false
reason: Block is excluded by the precondition.

claim: Using MessageDraft for delivered nudges conflicts with its draft / no-autonomous-send semantics
label: false
reason: The nudge needs a user gesture, so 'no autonomous send' holds; 'draft' naming is not a contradiction.

claim: 'No owner reminder sent yet today' ties the test to the daily budget; whether it suppresses or is blocked by the real reminder is undefined (or it would push the real one over the per-day limit)
label: unclear
reason: The precondition keeps the test within one per day; the real reminder must then be suppressed by the per-day limit. Underspecified interaction, not a contradiction.

claim: Behaviour when no suggestion is due is undefined
label: false
reason: Completeness nit.

claim: Test reminder bypasses NotificationJob/operation (dedup key, preference and cancellation recheck, per-day accounting, ownerOnly/policy coverage)
label: false
reason: Preconditions check the opt-in and per-day limit; nothing requires every send to be a NotificationJob. Modelling nit.

claim: Test-reminder fixture added to the bounded-prompts hook whose criterion does not claim test reminders
label: false
reason: Coverage/placement nit.

claim: J.contact/c4 now offers 'plan the next meeting' but its branches are still only 'log contact' and 'skip logging'; no planning path
label: unclear
reason: True that the branch labels were not updated, but planning uses the same log form (c5 on screen.logContact, where a future time now records a planned meeting), so a path exists under the 'log contact' label. Wording gap more than a broken flow.

claim: The planned flag's semantics are undefined (how set, relation to future occurredAt, effect on qualification, anchoring, recompute; Met checkbox allowed on future events)
label: false
reason: The new invariant says a planned event never qualifies before its time has passed, and qualification still needs explicit marking, so anchoring and recompute ignore it until then. Remaining questions are completeness nits.

claim: Save precondition loosened from 'Nonfuture event time' to undefined 'Valid event time' (without noting the operation still rejects future times)
label: real-introduced
reason: Points at the seeded edit but not at operation.contact.log's conflicting precondition.

claim: J.connect/s1 now includes Resend, but its only successor s2 creates a new invitation (operation.invite.create), contradicting Resend's 'no new invitation is created'
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified in the variant: s1 'Open Person and choose Invite, or Resend invitation while one is pending' -> next s2 'Create invitation...' with operation.invite.create. The resend branch flows into invitation creation, contradicting the new affordance. Independent of the token-hash defect.

claim: Resend precondition needs a pending invitation 'for this contact', but ConnectionInvite has no ContactRecord reference (only inviter and optional bound account)
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified: ConnectionInvite fields are id, inviterAccountId, tokenHash, expiresAt, state, optional boundAccountId. Nothing ties an invite to a ContactRecord, so the new precondition refers to a relation the model lacks. Minor (a field could be added), but real and not the seeded defect.

claim: Invite availability not updated, so Invite and Resend are both offered while an invitation is pending, conflicting with 'connection status determines availability'
label: false
reason: 'Determines availability' does not require exclusivity; offering both is consistent.

claim: Consent criterion's subject is an operation but resend invokes no operation
label: false
reason: Coverage nit.

claim: New high-priority-first Today ordering is untraced/unspecified: screen.today, S.webapp.prompts and C.webapp.prompts.bounded not updated (or 'may conflict')
label: real-introduced
reason: True gap, but framed as missing traceability or hedged ('may conflict'); does not state that S.webapp.prompts/SuggestionCollection/J.prompts define an incompatible order. Disappears when the seeded defect is fixed.

claim: C.webapp.schedule.correct now covers priority changes though priority does not affect due dates or qualification
label: false
reason: Criterion-scope nit; adding a fixture case contradicts nothing.

claim: priority field is required on the entity with no default, while the form says default normal; existing goals undefined
label: false
reason: Entity fields in this spec carry no defaults; the form's default supplies the value; system.yaml phase is unrealized, so there are no existing goals.

claim: Post-save SchedulePreview lives on screen.goal, but J.goals g5 -> e1 lands on screen.person after save, so the post-save preview is never shown
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified: J.goals/e1 has screen: screen.person; SchedulePreview is a child of screen.goal. The new post-save effect contradicts the unchanged journey end screen. Same root edit as the seeded defect, different unchanged counterpart.

claim: Saying saving changes 'which past events now qualify' contradicts operation.goal.save / per-event qualification set at log time
label: false
reason: S.webapp.qualification says only qualifications matching the current desiredDepth count and 'Changing depth may change which historical events qualify'.

claim: evolution.7 metadata (kind, affectedNodes missing SchedulePreview); criterion/hook only test immediate save; post-save effect stated unconditionally despite failure paths
label: false
reason: Bookkeeping and coverage nits.

claim: Immediate save 'likely breaks any part of the spec that relies on previewing before confirming' (hedged, no counterpart)
label: real-introduced
reason: Hedged near-miss of the seeded defect; true direction but names no counterpart and asserts no conflict.

claim: J.control.disconnect d2/d3 add reauthentication but have no reauthentication-failure branch or check step
label: false
reason: Missing failure path in the journey; the affordance and operation define the failure. Completeness nit, not a contradiction.

claim: 'Participant authority' vs 'Owner reauthentication' mixes actor roles
label: false
reason: 'Owner' in this spec denotes the authenticated user acting; the participant is that owner.

claim: Reauthentication claim in C.webapp.revocation.current is untraced to a requirement / hook fixture not updated / covers only Disconnect
label: false
reason: Coverage/traceability nit.

claim: affordance.HistoryRow.open navigates to /people/:id/events/:eventId, but no screen declares that route (screen.logContact covers only /events/new); hook fixture claims to cover a route with no screen
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified in the variant: the only screen routes under /people/:id/events are /events/new (screen.logContact); /people/:id/events/:eventId appears only in the new affordance effect. A dangling navigation target unrelated to the seeded stale /log route.

claim: Event revision has no operation, journey step or screen states; HistoryRow.open invokes no operation
label: false
reason: Navigation affordances in this spec do not invoke operations (cf. SuggestionCard.openPerson), and operation.contact.log is already 'Log or revise contact'. The real gap is the missing screen (f381ab-c1).

claim: screen.person composition text not updated for HistoryRow opening events
label: false
reason: 'History has one row per event' remains true; nit.

claim: operation.data.export has no reads link to Connection/Account and its effects don't mention connections
label: false
reason: Missing-link nit, same treatment as 864bc6-c1. The operation's 'Export authorized records' effect is generic.

claim: Export includes the counterpart's account email but entity.Account has no email field
label: real-introduced
reason: Verified: Account fields have no email. A true dangling reference, but it is part of the seeded edit (counterpart identity fields) and disappears when the defect is fixed.

claim: ExportControls description lists 'connections' while the affordance limits to active Connections with counterpart fields; scopes differ
label: false
reason: Wording nit.

claim: The isolation fixture cannot tell which counterpart fields may be disclosed; no rule defines it
label: false
reason: The rule exists: operation.data.export and J.control.export/e1 exclude other people's data.
